name: Robert the Unfaithful
source:
Robert has been married to his lovely wife, Vivian for 5 years. But when he goes on a conference for his job, he stays with his beautiful secretary, Jennifer.

[From [url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Robert_the_Unfaithful]Lesson of Passion Wiki[/url]]
